title: How to get a tech job without a CS degree using AI

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How can AI help bridge the gap between non-CS talent and tech jobs in the coming years?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: AI tools now generate code, automate testing, and offer real-time learning — making tech skills accessible to self-taught learners.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But over-reliance on AI risks devaluing human problem-solving and may widen inequality if access to these tools is uneven.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are creating open-source AI platforms and low-code environments to democratize access and reduce barriers.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI mentors guide learners through projects, validating skills without traditional credentials.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of tech hiring will balance AI-driven capability with human insight, redefining what it means to be a qualified developer.
